description: This class includes the manufacture of liquid or gaseous fuels and other products from crude petroleum, bituminous minerals or their fractionation products.
includes: manufacture of motor gasoline, kerosene, diesel fuel oils, heating fuel oils
manufacture of liquefied petroleum gases: propane, butane
manufacture of lubricating oils and greases
manufacture of petroleum jelly and paraffin wax
manufacture of petroleum coke and bitumen
manufacture of other petroleum-based products: white spirit, mineral spirit, naphthas
blending of biofuels with petroleum products
excludes: manufacture of coke oven products, see 1910
